test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A team of five members is sitting in a row facing towards the north. C is to the left of A and to the right of E. B is to the left of D and to the right of A. Who is sitting in the middle?
solution:
**Given:**

Step 1. Five members are sitting in a row facing towards the north.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/051800ab3a77dac327ee18d7e0c934f2ca583c67c5d561fbe2adf3059dfbd0f0.png] 

Step 2. C is to the left of A and C is to the right of E.

Case I:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac4651be3147edeabfd0ac57b5cc4853a68bb4c3ca5a29fe12aa5ea40e5f078a.png] 

Case II:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1aacfed6751bf725fea3c574d2be4db46825018be37c07d965ed663e5e68e0c0.png] 

Step 3. But, B is to the left of D and B is to the right of A. (Case II gets canceled)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b10952aad64b9d2b3c314b64d0fb93a366051f0768b6b68ef8685899f5afb6a.png] 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1).**
